title: sculptured.session/v1 line
description: One line of a .sculptured-session.jsonl file: the first line is a SessionHeader, each later line a SessionLine.

ActionClass.description: What a tool call did, classified by Sculptured (spec §6.4). Always heuristic.

check.description:
A shell command Sculptured runs in the agent's folder after each turn it finishes (exit 0 =
passed). None = no check.

data_access.description: What this agent reads and writes, and what else it changes (MADL `data_access`).

integrations.description: The components it is given, by id: built in (`kindex`, `signet`) or one of the team's.

minute_limit.description: Minutes this agent may spend working in one run (its children's included).

model.description: This agent's own model, overriding its group's and team's default for its kind. None = inherit.

skills.description: This agent's skills; only their names and descriptions are in its context until it uses one.

token_limit.description: Tokens this agent may use in one run; reaching it soft-stops the agent. None = no limit.

turn_limit.description: Turns this agent may take in one run (its children's included).

oneOf.description: Runs the stub driver: no model calls, no cost.
A typed answer or a chosen option's label.
Permission prompts: run the tool.
Permission prompts: do not run it.
Nobody answered in time (D8): an agent question is told to decide; a permission prompt is allowed.

Authority.description: The decisions an agent owns, in plain words.

scope.description: How far its decisions reach: a group id, or `system` for the whole team. None: its own work.

Caps.description: What a driver can do. The UI disables controls whose capability is false and says why.

ClaudeSetup.description: Which of the person's own Claude Code setup Claude agents load. Sculptured's own tools load either way.

global.description:
`~/.claude`: plugins, skills, hooks, settings and MCP servers. Off by default: a team's agents
rarely need them, and every agent re-reads them on every model call.

project.description: The agent folder's `.claude/` (settings, plugins, skills) and local settings. On by default.

briefing.description: What agents given it are told about it.

claude_only.description: Claude Code agents only (every tool hook is).

description.description: What it gives an agent, in a sentence or two.

install.description: How to install the program on a computer, shown when it is missing.

program.description: A program name (no path) the runner looks for on the agent's computer.

requires.description: Other components it needs, by id; they come with it.

oneOf.description: An MCP server over stdio: its tools sit next to Sculptured's.
A Claude Code PreToolUse hook run on every tool call, after Sculptured's own guard.
`delegates_to`: the giver starts before the receiver.
`escalates_to`: design intent, not enforced.
`can_observe`: design intent, not enforced.

ContextBasis.description: Where a context figure comes from.

oneOf.description: The CLI's own per-call total.
Sculptured adds up the CLI's numbers.

ContinueMode.description: How a run paused at a plan budget continues after its window resets.

oneOf.description: Each agent starts a fresh conversation from the note it wrote when the run wrapped up.
Each agent continues its own conversation (it re-reads all of it on every call).

Cost.description: An estimated cost in US dollars, with its source.

CostSource.description: Where a cost figure came from.

oneOf.description: Claude Code's own `costUSD` for the turn.
Sculptured's price table of OpenAI list prices (`OPENAI_PRICES_CHECKED`).

DataAccess.description: Paths relative to the agent's folder; a trailing `/` or `/**` covers a folder.

shared.description:
Values other agents rely on, each with the file that holds it (an idea from Constrain's
boundary register). Every start checks the file still contains it.

side_effects.description: Effects beyond its files, in plain words.

oneOf.description: The agent called `record_decision` (structured, agent-reported).
The agent's next message after the timeout (unstructured, agent-reported).
A permission prompt that Sculptured allowed on timeout (D8).
The agent did not say what it decided.

folder.description: Absolute path. Practice agents may leave it empty (they use the home folder).

id.description: Immutable; becomes the RigSpec member id.

job.description: Plain-language instructions, sent as the agent's first message at start.

id.description: Immutable; becomes the RigSpec pod id.

models.description: This group's model per provider; absent = inherit the team's.

Escalation.description: After `after_rounds` rounds at a stage, its items go to `agent` (typically a stronger model's agent).

cost.description: The turn's estimated cost and where it came from; absent when no source prices it.

in_turn.description: Counted from one model call while the turn ran (no cost); the turn's last report has the rest.

oneOf.description: controld keeps the message until a slot frees (the run budget's "most agents working at once").
A protection refused one of the agent's tool calls, with the reason the agent read.
The agent's context passed the team's ceiling: it writes its notes and continues fresh.

controld: this seat waits for these upstream seats (along "hands work to"
connections) to finish before it gets its first handoff, and whether its handoffs
are stuck. Empty and None = neither waiting nor stuck.

controld: these upstream turns were handed over to this seat as message `message_id`
in the start that began at `start_seq` (its `RigBooted`). Recorded in the same
transaction as that message, so a turn is never handed twice. `resend_of` names the
earlier message this one re-sends, when it is a resend.

wave.description: The "More work" wave this message belongs to, if any.

oneOf.description:
The operator asked this seat to hand its latest finished turn over again
("Hand over again"). `turn_seq` is that turn's `TurnEnded` seq.
The agent (or its CLI) asks the operator something and waits.
`late`: the question had already expired; the answer is an instruct message overriding the agent's decision.
The operator has seen an expired question; it leaves Needs you.

The agent's `report` call: findings about its work (agent-reported). `turn_id` is the
turn running when it was received, so the work ledger can place it in an attempt.
An agent report or tool call that failed validation (spec §6.3). Evidence; never interrupts the agent.
The operator asked for a new session (spec §6.8 handover). A reason is required.
A restore needs the operator: the resume failed or cannot be tried.

The turn ended on the provider's usage or rate limit (`text`: the CLI's words, verbatim; `resets`:
the time those words name, if any). The operator sends "continue" once it resets; Sculptured
never retries by itself. Recorded just before the turn's `TurnEnded { Failed }`.

controld launched this agent without optional abilities its host (an older agent runner) lacks:
`features` names them (`host_proto::features`), `note` says so in plain words and how to update.
Never posture: a restricted agent is refused instead.

A recorded answer could not reach the agent for certain (its host was not connected, or the
agent's program refused it): the question is open again. `reason`: the host's words, verbatim.

The agent's program reports the question settled (hostd maps the driver's `QuestionResolved`).
Sculptured records its own answer or expiry before delivering it, so a question still open
when this arrives was settled by the program itself, without Sculptured's answer. On an answered
(or expired) question it confirms the delivery.

The recorded answer (or expiry) may not have reached the agent: it was sent but no reply came, or a
"Send again" was refused. `reason`: the host's or program's words, verbatim. The question stays
answered; Needs you shows it until a "Send again" or the program confirms it.
A "Send again" of the recorded answer (or expiry) reached the agent: the doubt is cleared.

The model a session asked for and, once the CLI says, the model it reports using.
`requested`: what Sculptured passed (None = the CLI's own default). `observed`: the CLI's own
words (Claude `system/init.model`, Codex `thread/start` result `model` or `model/rerouted.toModel`);
None until the CLI says. Recorded after the session's `TenureStarted`, which clears the seat's model.

Intermediate reasoning the CLI showed (agent-reported). `text` verbatim, capped by
`model::cap::truncate(_, MAX_TEXT)`; "" when `form` is `Hidden`.

item_id.description: Codex reasoning item id; Claude message id.

oneOf.description: How full the agent's context was after a model call.

window_tokens.description: The CLI's runtime window (None = the CLI did not say).

oneOf.description: The CLI's report of how much of the signed-in plan is used (account-wide).
The run's budget changed state: `wrap-up` (its soft value was reached) or `stopped` (its hard value).
Sculptured began running the agent's check command (its design's "check", in its folder).
The check's outcome as Sculptured observed it: the command's own exit status, not the agent's word.

output.description: The last part of its combined output.

EventRecord.description:
One append-only event. `seq` is controld's global order (0 before ingest);
`(host, host_seq)` is the producer's identity for deduplication.

location.description: Where, as the agent put it (a file and line, a page, a part name). None when not given.

text.description: The finding in the agent's words.

Guard.description: A project check run every `every_minutes` while the team runs; while it fails, no new work goes out.

timeout_s.description: Seconds before the guard command is stopped (default 600, at most 3600).

requested_seq.description: Set when the operator's "Hand over again" sent this turn: that request's event seq.

turn_seq.description: The seq of that turn's `TurnEnded` event: the handoff's identity.

HandoffStuck.description: Why a seat's handoffs are stuck, in plain words naming agents (never seat ids).

can_resend.description: True when re-sending a recorded handoff can help (it was not sent or not delivered).

reason.description: E.g. "Airframe needs attention", "Planner has no job", "the handoff from Lead was not sent".

Join.description: How a review panel decides: every reviewer, or the first approval.

oneOf.description: The plan's allowance (Claude "session limit", "usage limit", "weekly limit"; Codex `usageLimitExceeded`).
A rate limit (Claude "rate limit"; Codex `rateLimitExceeded`).

ModelDefaults.description:
Per-provider model defaults for a team or a group. None = inherit (group, then team, then the
CLI's own default). An agent keeps its Claude-or-Codex kind and may override with `AgentAdvanced.model`.

claude.description: For Claude agents: an alias (`opus`, `sonnet`) or a full model id.

codex.description: For Codex agents: a model slug (e.g. `gpt-6-sol`).

Origin.description: How a line came to be: recorded by Sculptured, converted from another tool's file, or inferred by AI.

PlanBudget.description: A share of one plan window that a run may add, in percent of the window.

pause.description:
At the hard value: absent, every agent is stopped; set, the run pauses and continues by itself
once the window resets.

PlanPause.description: Pause at the hard value, then continue after the window resets, for at most `max_windows` windows.

PlanUsage.description:
A CLI's report of how much of the signed-in plan is used. Account-wide: it counts use from
outside Sculptured too.

credits.description: Codex: the credit balance, verbatim, when the plan has credits that use past the limit spends.

status.description:
The CLI's status word, verbatim (Claude `allowed`, `allowed_warning`, `rejected`; Codex the
limit it reached), if any.

PlanWindow.description: One window of a subscription plan's allowance, as the CLI reported it.

resets_at.description: When the window resets, Unix seconds.

used_percent.description: Percent of the window used, 0–100 (it can pass 100). None when the CLI did not say.

PortableSettings.description: The team settings that are part of its structure (not which computer runs it).

own_copies.description: Each Claude Code / Codex agent works in its own git copy.

Protection.description: A team's protections (Advanced). On by default.

context_tokens.description: Past this many tokens of context, an agent writes its notes and continues fresh.

read_kb.description: A read with no line range of a file larger than this many KB is refused.

shell_chars.description: The most shell output, in characters, that reaches an agent's context.

QuestionPrompt.description: What the agent asked, verbatim (capped). Shown as evidence, never rewritten.

allow_other.description: Free text is accepted besides the options.

tool.description: Permission prompts: the tool the agent wants to run.

tool_input.description: Permission prompts: the tool's input, verbatim.

oneOf.description: The agent called its `request_input` tool.
The CLI's own ask-the-user prompt (Codex `item/tool/requestUserInput`, a Practice agent's `ask:`).
The CLI asks before running a tool. Only a restricted posture produces these.
Try resuming the agent's previous session (again).
Start a fresh session; unfinished work is sent with the continue message.
Leave the agent stopped.

ReviewPersona.description: An angle a review-panel reviewer takes, so a panel covers what one reviewer would miss.

RiskFlag.description: A consequence worth a person's attention, in plain words. Never blocks anything.

text.description: Plain sentence, e.g. "force-pushed to origin main".

RunBudget.description: What one run of a team may use, all agents and their children together.

max_working.description: Most agents working at the same time; the rest wait for a free slot.

tokens.description: Tokens of every kind (input, output, cache reads and writes).

conditions.description: All must hold, such as `contains(parameters, 'rm -rf')` or `matches(file_path, '\\.env$')`.

reason.description: What the agent is told when the rule refuses its call.

tool_pattern.description: A regular expression over the tool's name (`Bash`, `Write`, `mcp__…`). Default: every tool.

Schedule.description: A message sent to `agent` every `every_minutes` while the team runs; skipped when the agent is busy.

parent.description: The agent that spawned this one, if any.

team.description: The team as of the run's start; null when it was not recorded (runs from before this format).

SessionMode.description: How a new session for an agent starts (spec §6.8 "handover"; "New session" in the UI).

oneOf.description: A new session primed with a handover note, then sent its unfinished work.
A native fork of the current session (Codex, Practice; not Claude in M2).

SharedValue.description:
A value at a boundary between agents, such as a port, an endpoint or a field name, and the file
(relative to the agent's folder) that must contain it exactly.

description.description: When to use it: what the agent sees until it loads the skill.

SoftHard.description: A limit with a soft and a hard value. `soft` absent = 85% of `hard`.

SoftHard2.description: A limit with a soft and a hard value. `soft` absent = 85% of `hard`.

StageKind.description: Who runs a stage: an agent (default), Sculptured running a command, or a person.

budget.description: What one run may use (Advanced). Absent = no budget.

claude_setup.description: Which of the person's own Claude Code setup Claude agents load (Advanced).

components.description: Components this team adds to Sculptured's built-in ones (from Community, or written by hand).

decision_log.description: People keep a decision log that agents read with read_decisions (Advanced).

folder.description: Default working folder for agents without their own override.

limits.description: Limits on the agents this team's agents spawn (Advanced). Absent = no limits.

models.description: The team's model per provider; absent = the CLI's own default.

protection.description: Rules between this team's agents and their tools (Advanced). On by default.

revision.description: Server-assigned save counter for optimistic concurrency.

safety.description: The team's safety rules (Advanced → Protections): tool calls they match are refused.

schedules.description: Messages sent to an agent every N minutes while the team runs (Advanced).

$schema.description:
The file's JSON Schema, for editors that validate and complete it. Written on export; any value is
accepted on import.

TeamInput.description:
The project's Input box on the Design board: the goal, links and notes the agents it points
to get with their Job when the team starts. (A workflow project uses its workflow's Input.)

TeamLimits.description: Limits a person set on a team's spawned agents. None = no limit; Sculptured sets none of its own.

max_agents.description: Most agents in the team at once, its own and spawned children together.

max_child_levels.description: Most levels of children: 1 lets the team's agents spawn children that cannot spawn their own.

ThinkingForm.description: What the CLI showed of a model's thinking.

oneOf.description: A summary of the reasoning (Claude thinking summaries, Codex reasoning summary).
The reasoning text itself.
Thinking happened but the CLI returned no text.

TokenCount.description: Which reported tokens count toward a limit.

oneOf.description: Input, output, cache reads and cache writes.
Everything except cache reads.

TokenLimit.description: A per-agent token limit for one run (since the team started).

include_subagents.description: Count the agents it spawns (and theirs) toward this agent's limit.

soft.description: The soft value: reaching it asks the agent to wrap up. Absent = 85% of `tokens`.

tokens.description: The hard value: reaching it stops the agent at once.

Wave.description:
A wave of "More work": started by one agent's finished work (or a "Hand over again"
press on it), it runs every agent downstream of that origin once.

id.description: The seq of the event that started it: the origin's `TurnEnded` or its `HandoverRequested`.

origin.description: The seat the wave started at.

copies.description: per-item: each item gets its own git branch and folder (Advanced).

guard.description: Pauses new work while this project check fails (Advanced).

input_position.description: Board placement only; changing it does not alter workflow execution.

agent.description: Empty for check and human stages.

command.description: check: the shell command, run in the team's project folder.

escalate.description: Hands items to a stronger agent after a number of rounds here (single-agent stages).

into.description: merge: the branch to merge into (default: the project's current branch).

max_rounds.description: How often one item may enter this stage; entering past it takes `on_limit`.

on_limit.description: The stage to take when `max_rounds` is reached; none blocks the item.

personas.description: The angle each panel reviewer takes, by agent id (ideas from Advocate). None: its own judgement.

position.description:
Board placement of the stage's own box (check, person, merge, review panel); none places it
automatically. Changing it does not alter workflow execution.

priority.description: Panel outcome order, worst first (default: blocked, then any non-"approved", then "approved").

prompt.description: human: what the person decides. The outcomes are the route keys.

reviewers.description: A review panel: 2–6 agents who all take the same item (instead of `agent`/`workers`).

routes.description: An outcome selects one route. Null completes this item; "blocked" is reserved.

timeout_s.description: check: seconds before the command is stopped (default 600, at most 3600).

workers.description: Additional interchangeable agents for concurrent topics at this stage.
